review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: Sidebar-shell Velt wireframe slots render with the live tag app-comment-sidebar-* (the .vc-* className survives the clone), while dialog/composer/thread wireframes render as *-internal (the type attr is preserved). CSS, probe selectors, and drive selectors must target the correct namespace per surface; a probe keyed to the wrong tag is a selector correction, not a defect.
learnings.evidence: privado Loop 133-4052; confirmed live by 3 builders + 2 judges + fixer

learnings.statement: velt-judge and velt-builder wedge repeatedly on heavy browser seed/scroll/click smoke drives (the sidebar toggle's first click can no-op; the comment List scrollHeight settles ~2-3s after open). Targeted getBoundingClientRect with a write-first/verify-once discipline is wedge-resistant; prefer it over full-frame visualDiff + heavy smoke.
learnings.evidence: 3 browser-drive wedges in one phase (judge1, judge2, fixer-inspection); getBBox verification succeeded

learnings.statement: Two concurrently-alive judges can race and clobber block-report.json — a wedged judge that RECOVERS after it was respawned runs alongside its replacement, and presence-only re-measures overwrite authoritative delta-compare defects. report-block.mjs offers no clean PASS-injection (only measure[browser] / account BLOCKED|GAP), so a clobbered report cannot be hand-restored. Enforce single-writer: confirm a wedged judge is truly dead before respawn, or freeze block-report (chmod 444) the instant a second writer appears.

visualDiff/pixel-diff is unreliable — and will fail the gate even when delta-compare is clean — when the live fixture card-count differs from the design frame (14 seeded vs 2 designed) or the isolated artboard background differs from the live app background (semi-transparent over the Figma canvas). Treat delta-compare (exact element dims) as authoritative; a phase like this needs the measurement fixture corrected (seed the design's exact card count + match the bg) for the gate to conclude mechanically.
learnings.evidence: gate exit 2 on visualDiff regions with deltaCompare.ok=true on all 8 blocks, Loop 133-4052

learnings.statement: A delta-compare size defect can be a mis-measure (composer submit reported 42x42 vs a real live 24x24). Verify any claimed dimensional defect with a live getBoundingClientRect before spending a fix attempt on it.
learnings.evidence: D1 confirmed non-defect after live check, Loop 133-4052
